output.description: Runs the markdown linter script against a post's source file in the content directory and returns the linter's findings. The post file is only read, not changed, but each run appends an entry (slug, ruleset, timestamp) to the .lint_history.jsonl log in the content directory.
output.declaring_phrase: appends an entry (slug, ruleset, timestamp) to the .lint_history.jsonl log
